title: Neon Parrot Live at Majestic Coffee
venue_description:
Neon Parrot Live at Majestic Coffee

Neon Parrot Live is an entertainment and live performance space in downtown Abilene that shares its home with Majestic Coffee on Pine Street. Guests enter through the coffee shop to reach the performance room. Owner Sam Wolfe runs Majestic Coffee and partners with Neon Parrot Live on a busy slate of community programming that includes a weekly songwriters' open mic.

History and Setting

The building has deep downtown roots. It began as a bank in the 1880s and later housed The Majestic theatre in the early 1900s. It went on to be Olympia Confectionary and an event venue and then the original Neon Parrot Lounge which opened as a live music lounge in 2015. Today Majestic Coffee fills the front with a plant-filled interior and vintage charm while Neon Parrot Live keeps the music tradition alive.

Songwriters' Open Mic Night

The Songwriters' Open Mic Night runs on Sunday evenings at 7:00 PM. Original songs are encouraged and covers are allowed when the performer accompanies themselves on an instrument. Sign-ups take place before the performances begin and the show is streamed on the Neon Parrot LIVE YouTube channel so performers get a recording of their set. Listings show the open mic continuing weekly into fall 2026.

Other Events

Neon Parrot Live also hosts a comedy open mic on Thursdays and a popular Senior Karaoke session on Tuesday afternoons at Majestic Coffee that draws participants from local senior centers. The room also books live shows such as touring and regional bands. Sam Wolfe describes his programming approach with the improv idea of yes and so the calendar stays varied and community focused.

Coffee and Menu

Majestic Coffee focuses on bean quality and minimal sweetness with craft espresso drinks and lattes. It is known for creative cereal-infused milks when available. Free Wi-Fi and plenty of outlets make it a good daytime work spot.

Good to Know

Majestic Coffee is open Monday through Saturday from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM and Sunday from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Follow Neon Parrot Live and Majestic Coffee on Facebook and Instagram for the current schedule.

title: Fat Boss Pub
venue_description:
Fat Boss Pub

Fat Boss Pub is a downtown Abilene gathering spot at 216 Pine Street. It serves cocktails and beer and pub food in a modern rustic setting with warm lighting and comfortable seating. It sits steps from other Pine Street favorites which makes it an easy stop on a downtown night out.

Atmosphere and Setting

The vibe is lively and social with big screens for sports and a room that fills up for live music. Staff check IDs at the door and the pub welcomes a mix of downtown regulars and college crowds.

Open Mic Night with Basic Truth

Fat Boss Pub hosts an open mic night on the fourth Sunday of the month hosted by the local band Basic Truth. The band helps players get set up and fills out the night with their own music. It is a friendly place for singers and pickers to try out songs in front of a supportive downtown crowd. Contact the pub or follow Basic Truth on Facebook to confirm the next date and start time.

Other Events

Wednesday nights bring Singo which is a song-based bingo game. The pub also books live music on weekends and food trucks often park nearby.

Food and Drink

Signature items include wings and half-pound burgers along with fried mushrooms and queso and fish tacos. The bar offers cocktails and beer and non-alcoholic options. Dine-in and takeout are available and the pub offers catering with advance reservations.

Good to Know

Fat Boss Pub is open Sunday through Wednesday from 3:00 PM to midnight and Thursday through Saturday from 3:00 PM to 2:00 AM. Call (325) 232-8775.
